name: Azimuth Graphics Options
author: Max Petrovsky (byzyn4ik)
description: Azimuth's graphics settings (frame rate, V-sync, resolution, display mode, graphics preset, shadows, texture filtering, anti-aliasing, HDR) on Forza Horizon 2's Video settings page and its sound settings (audio output, volume) on the Audio page; frame rate, display mode, shadow distance and volume apply at once.
